scope: One diagnostic process, four original rectangular zones with two complete interzone walls and two complete floor/ceiling pairs; not a delivered IdealLoads system.
weather: Exact original Gate0 constant synthetic full-year EPW, zero solar; same original bytes/hash retained in the execution declaration.
surfaces: Six outward-wound rectangular faces per zone; listed pairs use reciprocal Surface boundaries and identical massless R2 construction. All remaining faces explicitly Adiabatic. No windows, shading, gains, ventilation or infiltration.

construction.bound_scope: All264m2 inside surfaces below400K, emissivity1e-9; independently smaller than the fixed oracle band.

conditioning: Diagnostic IdealLoads in each zone with equal heating/cooling setpoint at the listed temperature, availability1, unlimited sensible capacity, heating supply50C/cooling13C, no humidification/dehumidification/outdoor air. No production DX acceptance inferred.

oracles.quantity: Surface Inside Face Conduction Heat Transfer Rate [W]; positive conduction toward the inside face

independent_vs_integration: The resistance/film heat-flow target is independently calculated. Reciprocal native pairing and signed conservation test implementation within this zero-storage steady state; no transient-mass or arbitrary-building validation.
stop_rule: Retain any setup/resource/numerical failure; do not tune temperatures, films, cases or thresholds. No automatic retries or additional cases.

subsequent_declared_production_checks.direct_native_and_recognized_replay: Same original generated A/B epJSON/weather/native arguments; exact labels/units/time/count. All annual/monthly/end-use kWh and interval demand kW within max(1e-6 reported unit,0.1% reference).
subsequent_declared_production_checks.timestep: Both unchanged four-zone designs:6 versus12 zone timesteps/hour. Align5-minute J pairs to ten-minute demand. Each annual facility difference<=1%, each coincident facility peak difference<=3%.
subsequent_declared_production_checks.comfort: Each design, each conditioned zone: occupied cooling-unmet<=1%, air temperature>setpoint+0.2C; disclose numerator/denominator and building interval union.
subsequent_declared_production_checks.qualification: All required checks remain distinct. A successful execution or same-engine replay does not substitute for independent physics or comfort/timestep acceptance.
